entities.title: Panels
entities.summary: The title, the docked hub and its pages, the same pages in flight, pause and the tunnels.
entities.purpose: hub.gd swaps the market, equipment, chart, system, pilot and hold pages; title.gd, pause_panel.gd and tunnel.gd are the other screens; look.gd is the shared look. A page asks the sim for every change and shows what it says.
boundaries: The sim decides which screen shows; panels send presses through SimHost.
